description: Self-hosted Python MCP server providing Claude with read/write access to a personal Outlook account via Microsoft Graph API. Runs on Ubuntu behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, accessible over HTTPS from any Claude client.

folder_structure.auth/: OAuth flow (oauth_flow.py) and encrypted token storage (token_store.py)
folder_structure.graph/: Microsoft Graph API client singleton (client.py) and domain operations: mail.py, calendar.py, contacts.py, tasks.py
folder_structure.agent-tmp/: Temporary agent workspace (gitignored, auto-deleted after 7 days)
folder_structure.agent-projects/: Active agent project folders with plan.md files
folder_structure.deploy/: systemd unit file (outlook-mcp.service) and Cloudflare Tunnel setup guide
